title: Add Correlated Delivery Variability and Configurable Shot Study Controls
acceptance: Support jointly Gaussian shaft rotation, path, speed, horizontal/vertical strike, lean and attack variations with validated PSD covariance, paired draws and user-editable GUI parameters. Defaults include rotation SD1/2deg, path .5deg, speed1/2mph, strike .25inch eachaxis. Report realized face/path covariance and unsupported trajectories without resampling.
